snippet.title: Auto Jurassic Knights Announcement Trailer #2
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882680/Auto_Jurassic_Knights/

Build your squad of medieval dinosaur knights and battle your way to victory! 🦖⚔️

In Auto Jurassic Knights, every round is a new test of strategy and risk. Spend your limited gold to recruit unique dino-soldiers, combine units to power them up, and discover wild synergies as you assemble your ultimate team. Once your lineup is set, the fight begins automatically leaving the results to your planning, instincts, and a bit of luck.

With a streamlined, fast-paced loop, each run is a tense push-your-luck adventure:

Draft & Combine – Recruit fierce dinosaurs or human soldiers and merge them to unlock stronger forms.

Dynamic Battles – Watch your squad clash automatically while you prepare for the next round.

Medieval WWI Aesthetic – A unique fusion of knights, dinosaurs and guns!

Whether you’re testing new combos, going all-in for quick power, or carefully evolving your perfect squad, every decision matters. 

Play Auto Jurassic Knights and start building your team today!
